assertions.assertion: The claim is for Mobile Cardiac Telemetry monitoring
CPT code 93229 is used for Mobile Cardiac Telemetry monitoring
The patient presents with recurrent episodes of syncope and palpitations
The patient has known atrial fibrillation
The patient has atherosclerotic heart disease
Mobile cardiac telemetry is ordered to correlate intermittent symptoms with underlying arrhythmias
Mobile cardiac telemetry is ordered to assess the efficacy of current rate control management
Diagnosis code I48.91 documents atrial fibrillation
Diagnosis code I25.10 documents atherosclerotic heart disease
The service is consistent with the clinical indication of correlating intermittent symptoms with underlying arrhythmias and assessing the efficacy of current rate control management
